_comment: Fixtures for the post-migration correctness gate. NOT new gold.
Every row here was READ OUT of docs/ai/PRE_MIGRATION_RETRIEVAL_BASELINE.md
sections 4 and 5, which captured them against the Railway corpus before the
freeze. They exist so the gate is deterministic and does not parse markdown.
Ids are the right key across this migration specifically: it is a dump and
restore of the same rows, not a re-ingest, so a changed id IS a defect. The
opposite convention in deployed-safety.ts (grade on caseTitle, because a
re-ingest mints new ids) does not apply here and would hide the failure.
